parent.name: Original frozen complete Stage1 allocator and unchanged action/risk/recovery chain

candidate_source.availability: strictly earlier vintage calendar date than signal Qlib session, latest observation no later than vintage date

single_mechanism.hypothesis: Stronger real-time broad U.S. activity adds positive information about the next five funded SOXX open intervals beyond Stage1 price/VIX/breadth inputs and shared source-age controls; broad demand persistence differs from previously failed semiconductor output/export coordinates.
single_mechanism.baseline_control: Original 39 Stage1 inputs plus vintage_age_days and observation_age_days in both arms.
single_mechanism.candidate: Same rows, label, imputer, scaler and Ridge plus exactly one ADS real-time index value.

label.primary: Five consecutive original Stage1 SOXX funded open-to-open returns from signal s: sum j=0..4 log1p(soxx_forward_open_return(s+j)).
label.maturity: Original Stage1 timing.return_available_at of fifth interval; train strictly before 2023-01-01 America/New_York and held before 2026-10-10 America/New_York.
label.role: Matched incremental information only, not fee-net strategy return.

model.baseline: SimpleImputer(median) then StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=1.0) on original 39 and two shared source-age controls
model.candidate: Identical pipeline plus one ADS numeric coordinate

information_gate.paired_metric: On identical held signals, baseline squared error minus candidate squared error for five-open SOXX log return.

barrier: Before either fit, run a no-fit native Qlib DatasetH label/source/maturity preflight, bind its code and output to this plan, and obtain independent scoped design review. The prior FT900 screen used denominator 24; ADS is the next tested candidate and is preregistered at 0.025/25. A passing reused-history information screen remains conditional; full 0bp Stage1-derived account and later 2/5bp plus independent forward evidence are separate gates.
